questions.question: The LORD said the prophets of Samaria led His people Israel astray. True or false?
Why did the LORD of Hosts say He would feed Jerusalem's prophets wormwood and give them poisoned water?

answers.text: Ungodliness spread from them through the land
They moved their altars out to Samaria
They stopped teaching the priests the law

questions.question: The LORD said some prophets were filling people with false hopes. Where did their visions come from?

answers.text: From the priests in the temple
From the elders at the gate

questions.question: The LORD said He sent the prophets who were giving the people false hopes. True or false?
